title: Pipe Dream
story: Three programs work together like an assembly line to build a secret passphrase. Once it's ready, pass it into the final gatekeeper to unlock your flag.
description:
1. The Assembly Line: Chain /challenge/stage1, /challenge/stage2, and /challenge/stage3 together so each program passes its output directly to the next. The final stage prints your secret passphrase.

2. The Gate: /challenge/checker verifies the passphrase, but it refuses manual keyboard typing and command-line arguments—feed the passphrase directly into its standard input to get the flag.
